clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau once walked into a secret society mansion expecting to learn every wealth secret at once.

He'd been invited into a group called The Brotherhood, pad of paper and pen ready, certain this one meeting would hand him the missing key to all his goals and dreams.

Instead, they asked him something strange: what if just one phrase could hold everything you need - but only for this exact season of your life? He said yes, of course.

Then came the real twist: there wasn't one phrase. There were many, each one given only when he was ready for it.

What lesson do you think you're finally ready for right now?
